description:
Hey,
the Devil Wears Prada 2 is back—taking over Seoul.

What happens when the world’s most perfect fashion icon meets the smartest AI supporter, Samsung Bespoke AI Laundry? 
Straight from the heart of Seoul, this ultimate collaboration has arrived in major sites: Gangnam, Gwanghwamun and Myeongdong.
A splash of coffee on a red silk dress. ☕️💃One tiny slip-up that could ruin everything. 
But with Bespoke AI✨, the crisis is over. It intelligently senses the fabric and the stain, 
auto-adjusting water and detergent to bring your look back to its original elegance.

Perfection is simply non-negotiable.
“Groundbreaking. That’s all.” 👠
#TheDevilWearsPrada2, now playing only in cinemas. 

Learn more about Bespoke AI Laundry Combo: http://smsng.co/bespoke-home

#EnablingBetterLiving #BespokeAILaundry #BespokeAILaundryCombo #BespokeAI #Samsung
title: 'The Devil Wears Prada 2' meets Bespoke AI Laundry in Seoul｜Samsung
